content:
jon_sales: Heads up — Acme and BetaCorp both opened asks for per-customer model pinning (they want to pin different model versions per tenant). Putting both requests in one thread to decide merge/prio.

kevin_support: Links to the tickets: https://support.redwood/acme/123 and https://support.redwood/betacorp/456. Both mention wanting a console control and an API flag. Acme mentions fallback behavior explicitly.

maria_pm: +1. Let's merge into a single canonical product request. Quick Q: is this purely routing/config or will it touch runtime caching and KV behavior?

tara_eng: Runtime impact: we'll need to add route-level metadata and a pin field that short-circuits smart-routing logic. Minimal kernel changes but notable rollout/testing surface (cache invalidation, KV use patterns). Rough estimate: 2 sprints for an MVP, 4+ for full console + rollout features.

alex_pdm: From customer POV — both customers want: 1) an API flag to pin model version per tenant/route, 2) console toggle for non-technical users, 3) telemetry for pinned routes. BetaCorp specifically asked for canary/gradual rollout controls.

sophie_sales: BetaCorp says they'd pay for early access if we can deliver a beta in ~8 weeks. Acme is fine waiting a quarter but wants an update & timeline.

maria_pm: Proposed approach:
1) Create canonical Jira PRD-371 and merge Zendesk threads under it.
2) Tag as: customer-request, pilot-candidate.
3) Owner: @maria_pm.
4) Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- API: request-level "model_pin" flag accepted by router.
- Router: pinned requests always route to pinned model variant, with safe fallback to global model if pinned variant unavailable.
- Metrics: latency and token-cost broken down for pinned vs not pinned.
- Docs: API and migration notes.
(Full scope: console UI, canary controls, per-tenant rollout policies).

kevin_support: Can we get more detail from Acme on expected traffic patterns per tenant and whether they need per-route pinning or per-org? I can follow up on exact asks.

tara_eng: Implementation notes: add pin to routing policy, check pin before smart-routing; fallback behavior to ensure availability. We also need unit/integration tests and a canary rollout plan. Risk: cache fragmentation might increase token cost; we'll need to measure.

maria_pm: I'll draft the PRD this afternoon. Does anyone object to targeting Q2 for the MVP? We need to weigh against Optimize and the ongoing billing work.

alex_pdm: Suggest medium priority by default. If BetaCorp confirm the pilot budget we bump to high and allocate a short dedicated effort.

sophie_sales: I'll confirm budget and timeline with BetaCorp by EOD Monday and report back here.

deploy-bot: Created Jira PRD-371: https://jira.redwood/browse/PRD-371 and linked the two support tickets.

maria_pm: Next steps from here:
- PM (me) will merge the Zendesk threads into PRD-371 and post draft acceptance criteria + rough timeline.
- Support (kevin) to collect traffic numbers, desired granularity (route vs org).
- Eng (tara) to provide MVP vs full estimates and confirm rollout strategy.

kevin_support: I will ping Acme + BetaCorp for traffic numbers and example configs today.

jon_sales: Thanks — please add labels: customer-request, per-tenant-pinning, backlog-merged and cc me on PRD. Also confirm which customer is open to paid pilot.

maria_pm: Done. PRD draft will be up by Thu (4 days). If BetaCorp confirms budget we can reprioritize for an earlier slot. For customer comms I propose two options to present:
- MVP: API "model_pin" + router fallback (shorter ETA).
- Full: Console controls + canary rollout + telemetry (longer ETA).

kevin_support: Sounds good, I'll update both customers once draft is up.

alex_pdm: One more ask: include telemetry for pinned routes (latency, token-cost delta, error rates) in the acceptance criteria so customers can validate.

maria_pm: Added telemetry to acceptance criteria. Thanks everyone — I'll post the PRD link when it's ready.

jon_sales: :thumbsup:
